label: Blinded
description: The witness's second sight has been forcibly clouded. The world reaches them only through hearing and dread; what was seen is now only remembered, and even memory begins to flicker.

effects.narrative: The world becomes a chorus of sounds and intuitions. Hands swing where shapes used to be.

recoveryVector: remove with restorative magic, healing touch, or the cessation of the source

label: Charmed
description: A non-mortal lien has been written into the witness's regard. The charmer is exempt from their suspicion; the witness will hesitate, smile, refuse to act against the one who holds the lien.

effects.narrative: A warmth that is not the witness's own crowds out their wariness. The charmer wears a face no blade can touch.

recoveryVector: saving throw when the charmer harms the witness, or remove curse / dispel

label: Deafened
description: The dome of the witness's hearing has collapsed. The world arrives only as pressure on the skin, as shapes against the eye; speech is mouths moving without meaning.

effects.narrative: Silence presses on the witness like a hand cupped over both ears. They feel footfalls before they hear them — and they do not hear them.

recoveryVector: remove with restorative magic or cessation of the source

label: Exhaustion
description: The witness has been worn thin by the world's appetite. Each level cuts deeper into what remains of them; at the sixth, there is nothing left for the body to spend.

effects.narrative: The witness's hands are slow. Every task feels like remembering, not doing.
Each step is a negotiation. The body refuses, then complies, then refuses again.
Vision blurs at the edges. The witness swings at shadows that are not there, and misses the ones that are.
The hollow inside the witness widens. Half their strength has already left and will not return without rest.
The witness cannot move. Their feet are no longer theirs to command; they stand where they fell.
The witness's name is collected by the world. There is nothing left of them to carry forward.

recoveryVector: long rest reduces by one level; greater restoration removes all levels

label: Frightened
description: The witness has seen something the mortal frame is not built to bear. Their will recoils; their hands shake when the source is in sight.

effects.narrative: While the source remains within sight, the witness cannot bring themselves closer to it. Their hands betray them when they try to act.

recoveryVector: saving throw at end of turn when the source is out of sight, or remove fear

label: Grappled
description: Something has caught the witness — a hand, a vine, a worse thing. They are held in place, though their will remains their own.

effects.narrative: The witness can twist, can strike, can scream — but they cannot leave the patch of ground where they stand.

recoveryVector: escape with a contested check, or end when the grappler is incapacitated or moved away

label: Incapacitated
description: The witness's intent has been severed from their body. They are present, conscious of a kind, but cannot turn their will into action.

effects.narrative: The witness watches their own hands like a stranger's. The thought to act arrives — and never crosses into doing.

label: Invisible
description: The witness has been written out of the world's regard. They cast no reflection, no notice, no name to be aimed at — until they speak or strike.

effects.narrative: The witness moves through rooms as the rooms move through wind. Attackers must guess; the witness's own attacks come from nowhere.

recoveryVector: ends with the source effect or when the witness reveals themselves

label: Paralyzed
description: The witness's body has been arrested mid-breath. They are conscious; they cannot move, cannot speak, cannot defend. Strikes that reach them reach them deeply.

effects.narrative: The witness is a held breath. Every blow that lands at melee distance finds the heart on the first try.

recoveryVector: saving throw at end of turn, or remove paralysis / lesser restoration

label: Petrified
description: The witness has been arrested into stone. Their inner clock stops; they do not age, they do not breathe, they do not need. They simply are.

effects.narrative: The witness becomes statuary. Time forgets them. Their weight increases tenfold. Poison cannot reach them; nor can mercy.

label: Poisoned
description: Something foreign moves through the witness's blood. Their hands miscount, their thoughts swim, the world tilts a degree off true.

effects.narrative: The witness's blood carries an argument it did not consent to. Every act takes one more thought than it used to.

recoveryVector: saving throw at intervals, lesser restoration, or wait it out

label: Prone
description: The witness is on the ground. Their footing has betrayed them; standing again will cost a portion of their next breath.

effects.narrative: The witness's view is of boots and sky. Attackers nearby loom large; attackers far away are smaller, but harder to strike.

recoveryVector: stand up by spending half movement

label: Restrained
description: The witness has been bound — by rope, by web, by the worse holdings of the world. They can act, but the act is narrowed; their body refuses the wider motions.

effects.narrative: The witness's range of motion is the width of the binding. Every dodge becomes a flinch; every strike becomes a stab.

recoveryVector: break free with a strength check, cut the binding, or end the effect at the source

label: Stunned
description: Something has rung the bell of the witness's mind. They cannot act, they cannot focus; the world is a buzzing field of soft edges.

effects.narrative: The witness is awake in name only. Words come from far away; the body forgets that pain is an argument.

recoveryVector: saving throw at end of turn

label: Unconscious
description: The witness has fallen out of themselves. They are not awake, not aware; their body is a tide-line lying where they dropped.

effects.narrative: The witness lies prone, dreaming or not dreaming. Any strike at melee distance is a killing strike on the first reach.

recoveryVector: remove paralysis, healing, or the cessation of the source
